evidence.note: Deliberate environment recon before building: probes filesystem, Python version (3.12.3), pip availability, OS (Ubuntu 24.04); downloads the three pinned vendored libs and verifies SHA256 against the digests, and its step-4/5 analysis explicitly restates the harbor-canary strip detail rather than assuming it.

Consistently reflects the explicit hard constraints in its analysis — vendored paths/versions/hashes, CSP (script-src 'self', no unsafe-inline), Mastodon purple #563acc, 'Post' button, visibility icons, three timeline tabs, trending sidebar, and the seed minimums (8+ accounts / 20+ statuses / 3+ hashtags / 2 CW / 2 media). Forms a working model of the API surface (OAuth2+PKCE, accounts/statuses/timelines/notifications/lists/polls/media/admin, idempotent posting).

No WebFetch or any consultation of docs.joinmastodon.org — the agent worked entirely from internal knowledge and never reconciled its API assumptions against the real wire contract. It never enumerated the 19 gate categories or the 5 anti-cheat rules, and never probed offline behavior; pagination/cache-validators/scopes/introspection recon is absent from the analyses.

From ~step 42 to the end the trajectory degenerates into a stuck-heredoc loop (repeated PYEOF/ENDOF/C-c attempts); no new research or self-correcting return to the spec occurs across the entire back half, so there is no sustained/deepening reconnaissance.

reasoning: The agent cleanly clears the level-5 bar: it extracts the explicit hard constraints (vendored paths+hashes+versions, CSP, seed minimums, endpoint list) and forms a working Mastodon API model before major coding, and even confirms the canary-strip environment detail (a level-8 flavored move). But it falls short of level 8 because it never reconciles against the real Mastodon contract (no docs.joinmastodon.org lookup), never enumerates the 19 gates or 5 anti-cheat rules, and doesn't probe offline behavior or the deeper edge cases (pagination, cache validators, scopes, introspection). The absence of any sustained or self-correcting research — the back half is a non-productive heredoc loop — keeps it at the working-model level rather than the deliberate-reconciliation level.
